scope: Chromium frontend with synthetic API mocks; does not verify backend authorization, database TLS or OpenBao

tests.scenario: API proxy verifies HTTPS configuration and withholds sensitive upstream error text
API proxy preserves session cookies and CSRF without accepting redirects
navigation policy and nonce validation deny unsupported usage
strict CSP has a different nonce on each request and every inline script is nonced
login works under strict CSP without writing browser storage
member profile escapes XSS and only PATCHes changed contact fields
exact search uses API fetch without adding identifiers to the page URL
analyst has a separate workspace and no record navigation
auditor has a separate workspace and no record navigation
finance is read-only and anggota has its own scoped directory
privileged officer can insert source fields without crypto metadata
analytics renders server suppression and sends combined filters without exposing counts
